headline: As of 2026-10-26: 31,371,120 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 48 of 50 states, D+11.3 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 31,371,120 early/mail ballots cast so far across 48 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+11.3 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Texas (4,649,453), California (3,276,574), Florida (3,138,889).
